title: Trade Show Swag Inventory 2025
body:
Quick inventory note — rough counts from the storage closet and recent events.

Overview:
- Purpose: capture current swag stock ahead of 2025 conferences (mostly mockups and giveaways). This is a working sheet; counts are approximate.

Inventory (item | approx_qty | location | condition | notes):
- Redwood logo stickers | 1,200 | closet-shelf-A | mixed | some sheets stuck together, 2 boxes opened
- T-shirts (navy, L) | 24 | closet-shelf-B | mixed | 12 from 2023 prototype (slightly different logo), 12 new
- T-shirts (charcoal, M) | 10 | box-7 | new | missing size tags on 3
- Hoodies (gray, XL) | 6 | box-9 | new | sample batch with zipper defect on 1
- Laptop stickers (die-cut) | 450 | drawer-3 | new | assorted colors
- Enamel pins | 40 | small-drawer | good | missing backing on 2
- Notebooks (dot-grid) | 150 | shelf-top | mixed | spiral binding loose on 4
- Reusable water bottles | 30 | box-2 | good | lid mismatch on 1
- Webcam covers | 0 | n/a | none | used as sunny-day promo, need reorder
- Prototype keychains | 12 | box-prototypes | poor | brittle plastic, for internal only

Discrepancies & questions:
- Two unlabelled boxes in storage room; suspect additional stickers and a pile of 'beta' postcards. Need to open and reconcile.
- Past vendor sent 50 extra water bottles last year — not logged in procurement. Who approved this? See linked expense.

Action items:
- [ ] Sophie: open unlabelled boxes and update counts (due 2025-02-20)
- [ ] Liam: confirm reorder thresholds for webcam covers and badges (due 2025-02-18)
- [ ] Maya: verify budget line in 2025-BUDGET-GTM (due 2025-02-25)

Storage notes: closet is at HQ warehouse A-level; recommend moving high-value items to locked cabinet and logging checkouts in shared sheet. Keep old prototype shirts in separate bin to avoid confusion.

Notes to self: Found a random pile of stickers with older vendor watermark — maybe donate? Also, brainstormed mini-puzzle item for booth (low-cost).
